notes: Single source of truth for which DSH versions this plugin declares support for.
tier=declared is blocking: a release may not ship while any declared target fails.
tier=advisory is informational: it is reported and reviewed, but never blocks.
The product only supports DSH >= 0.2.1 (lib/meta.mjs DSH_MIN_SUPPORTED); 0.1.x
and 0.2.0 are not supported at all, so they must not appear here.
Older release lines are covered by their LAST rc (alphas are not); the newest
line is covered including its prereleases, because that is what users run first.
era describes the host integration the version is expected to use; the harness
derives expected log lines and API availability from it (see lib/matrix.mjs).
ui is the client face the version renders: every supported version (0.2.1,
prereleases included) renders the same one, so it is always modern.
The legacy settings-namespace channel is gone: expect.settingsNamespace is
